summary.headline: Judging Parents and Their Deaths
summary.text: Astrological rules for judging the parents’ status, freedom, birth, and life from syzygies, the Sun and Moon, benefics, malefics, rulers, applications, transits, periods, and returns, citing Valens and Antigonus. A new section gives methods for determining which parent dies first using parental lots, rays, angular and subterranean positions, signs, triplicities, and a full Moon in Pisces.
